Definition: Elasah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elasah or Eleasah = "God has made"; 1) a descendant of Judah, son of Helez; 2) a priest of Pashur's line with a foreign wife during Ezra's time; 3) Shaphan's son, Zedekiah's servant; 4) a descendant of Benjamin, son of Rapha, father of Azel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
